eyebrow: What the Policy Engine actually weighs
code:
Trust algorithm inputs (NIST SP 800-207):
  CDM system        - asset/device state
  Threat intel feed - known bad indicators
  Activity logs     - network + system behavior
  Data access policy
  PKI / certificates
  Identity management system
  SIEM data

-> one combined grant / deny / revoke decision
caption: The PE pulls signals you already collect into a single decision, not seven separate ones.
